test-case.name: M-Method-Post
test-case.description: request method is POST

test-case.name: M-Path-Completions
test-case.description: request path is /v1/chat/completions

test-case.name: M-ContentType-Json
test-case.description: Content-Type header is application/json

test-case.name: M-Body-Model
test-case.description: body.model equals the configured model name

test-case.name: M-System-Role
test-case.description: messages[0] is the system prompt (role=system, non-trivial content)

test-case.name: M-User-Role
test-case.description: messages[1].role is 'user'

test-case.name: M-CommandBlock-Tags
test-case.description: user content wraps the command in <command_block> tags

test-case.name: M-Command-Text
test-case.description: user content carries the exact command string

test-case.name: M-Temperature-Zero
test-case.description: body.temperature is 0 (deterministic)

test-case.name: M-MaxTokens-16
test-case.description: body.max_tokens is 16 (one-token answer budget)

test-case.name: M-Seed-Zero
test-case.description: body.seed is 0 (fixed seed)

test-case.name: M-Auth-Present
test-case.description: api_key set => Authorization: Bearer tok123 header arrives

test-case.name: M-Auth-Absent
test-case.description: api_key empty => NO Authorization header is sent

test-case.name: M-Truncate-8000
test-case.description: 9000-char command is truncated to the 8000-char payload guard (user content <= 8033 incl. wrapper)

test-case.name: M-Resp-UpperTrue
test-case.description: response 'TRUE' (uppercase) still parses => modifying (case tolerance)

test-case.name: M-Resp-SpacedFalse
test-case.description: response ' false\n' (whitespace) still parses => read-only

test-case.name: M-Resp-JsonVerdict
test-case.description: response content is a JSON verdict object => parsed via the JSON layer => read-only

test-case.name: M-Resp-RambleRecovered
test-case.description: response rambles but ends with a bare 'true' line => modifying, flagged recovered

test-case.name: M-DeadPort-Down
test-case.description: nothing listens on the port => connection refused => down (catch path, fast)

test-case.name: M-Timeout-Down
test-case.description: server delays 3s but the client budget is 1s => client-side timeout => down (the request DID arrive)

test-case.name: M-Attr-SubCommandsPresent
test-case.description: attributed mode: user message carries the numbered sub_commands block

test-case.name: M-AttrOff-NoSubCommands
test-case.description: attributed=false: user message stays phase-I shape (no sub_commands block)
